review.notes: Accepted with corrections applied in place. Checked: upstream form (Summary, Scope and ownership, Conventions, Exact supplier contracts, How to read the build, eight layers with Examples and Dependencies, Downstream consumers, References; no process language); fidelity of all 121 plan targets by a scripted packet-to-README comparison (119 own sections plus the two supplier-only nodes in the contracts; all 263 API names present; every definition and construction has at least three Checks; substantive statement changes checked against EPW (4.2), LZ 6.2 and Skinner-Wiles Prop. 3.3); all 18 public sources fetched with hashes equal to the packager's, the three cleared-library copies read in place; every locator by script (327 label-page pairs) plus Hida equation labels on page images and some 30 statements read by hand; suppliers by tier (all lower tiers or upstream Tau Ceti, except KatoEulerSystems) and a Sonnet cross-check of every supplier-contract item; duplication against current TauCetiRoadmap and Tau Ceti a91d3aaf (none); an adversarial pass over every Check, convention and worked example. Corrected: (1) supplier contracts rewritten per supplier as Uses vs Required in addition: upstream IntegralHeckeAndGaloisDeterminants 2.3/0.6 supply only the commutative factorial idempotent and the projective determinant law, so the ordinaryIdempotent and projCharpoly interfaces are now targets with proofs; atlas IHG ids replaced by upstream sections; AdicSpacesPartII stage attribution fixed and irreducible components of rigid spaces (Conrad-IC 2.2.7, 2.2.9, 4.2.2, 4.3.2) stated as a requirement; ModularCurvesPartII Igusa tower, relative homology, mod-p multiplicity one and the ordinary p-divisible filtration stated as required additions; LocallyAnalyticDistributions radius links, R04.3 tangent constraints, P7 'good complexes' and ModularForms Layer 8G semisimplicity corrected; (2) 1.3 proof: the unproved rational freeness step replaced by a generic-rank argument; (3) 0.2 restored to Katz's hypothesis N0 >= 3 or p >= 5; (4) 1.8 hypothesis is the double-annihilator identity, not reducedness; (5) 0.15 notation clash; (6) eight wrong locators (EPW Thms 2.3.1, 2.3.4; Buzzard Lemma 2.11, Thm 3.3, Lemma 5.10; Hida (1.12), (1.6)-(1.9), Cor. 4.2 proof) and Conrad-IC moved to the free journal pagination; source bibliography numbers replaced by works; (7) references completed (Buzzard, Conrad) and process wording removed; (8) LaTeX front matter rewritten in Unicode, standing conventions of Layers 2-3 stated once, filler lines removed, Lean milestones named in the README, 225 glued words spaced. lean-check: exit 0, 21 warnings, all 'declaration uses sorry' (Suggested.lean unchanged, 176 lines, Mathlib only); run_cmd audit: no sorry in any type or data; check_sorry_data passes; intake check-files 0 problems. For the maintainer: KatoEulerSystems (Layer 4, sections 4.3 and 4.5-4.9) is outside the 94-roadmap order; it takes nothing from PadicFamilies, so it must be placed below tier 16 or Layer 4 waits. Open requests to lower-tier suppliers are listed in the report.
